payload.retro_drained: Killer met: inbox 4 -> 0, each with a disposition - one pulled into this iteration (the phone-publish rule and its two mechanical gaps), one to i11 (sub-machine navigability), one to i9 (maximize modifiers), one to the engine-determinizer home (restoring the parallel battery).
payload.goal: The phone loop matches its design: a gate the owner must adjudicate reaches them as a working ntfy card AND a browsable hosted brief, and a tap actually returns a grant.
payload.pulled_in:
GROUNDED IN THE DESIGN DOC AND v1, read before scoping.

(a) THE DEFECT, from the owner's own tap: the lane builds its action as url "answer:<topic>", which is not a URL scheme, so ntfy answers 'Expected URL scheme http or https but was answer'. v1 shows the intended shape and names the trap in its own comment - the topic is kept BARE in the header and ABSOLUTIZED against the adapter's base before sending. v2 copied the bare topic and never absolutized. Origin: owner-witnessed, se-v2-design §19 item 3 had listed this exact leg as never verified.

(b) v1's CARD SHAPE, ported rather than reinvented (ask.go ntfyHeaders): X-Title naming the kind and the check; a gate renders visibly distinct - high priority, bangbang tag - from an ordinary decision; up to three actions, dropping to two when a hand-off page exists so the third slot can carry `view, open hand-off, <page>`.

(c) THE HOSTED BRIEF, se-v2-design §11 tier 1 and §18, and v1's adr-handoff-html: ONE browsable page per bless moment, self-contained, its key riding the URL fragment so the host sees ciphertext only; published to Workers KV with an expiration_ttl; read-after-write verified before notifying, because KV is ~60s eventually consistent; the page's link travels as the card's view action. BOTH PREREQUISITES VERIFIED BEFORE SCOPING: the cloudflare_kv token is present in the environment, and the §18 worker still serves (HTTP 404 on an unknown key = alive).

(d) THE PUBLISH RULE, from note-3f1437f22172: a gate the owner is meant to bless always reaches the phone - an unattended self-blessing run needs nothing. Plus its two mechanical gaps: the board reads phone.json only at startup, so restoring config does nothing until it is cycled; and no publish success or failure is reported anywhere, so a silent transport failure is indistinguishable from a working lane.
payload.left_out:

- The full cone render as collapsed colour-coded rows (v1's adr-handoff-html): the page carries the offer's brief and evidence; the cone render is a later enrichment of the same page.
- The artifact tier (§11 rung 3) and plain chat (rung 4): they already work, and nothing here changes them.
- Slack: deferred in v1 and still deferred.
- Restoring the parallel battery: routed to the engine-determinizer home, not this iteration.
- Anything touching the close, the machine or the board panels: i5e, i11 and i9 respectively.
payload.rigor:
Systematic with the design-input phase reduced, under se.decision-refine-mode - and this time the reduction is honest rather than assumed, because the design IS already ruled in two places: se-v2-design §11 (the adjudication ladder) and §18 (the transport, built and verified 2026-07-21), plus v1's adr-handoff-html, adr-ntfy-actions and adr-answer-authenticity. STRUCK: M4 candidate generation and M5 Pugh selection - re-deciding a transport that is specified AND has a working v1 implementation would be decision theater; the enumerated alternatives and their eliminations already live in the design doc. REDUCED: M1 vision inherits se.vision by pointer; M2/M3 compress because the requirements are the doc's own bullets plus the defect. KEPT AT FULL STRENGTH, because delivery never shrinks and because this iteration exists precisely BECAUSE an unverified leg shipped: M6 prove, where the transport is exercised live end to end - encrypt, PUT, read-after-write, notify, open, tap - rather than assumed from the doc; M7 build red-first; M8 validate; M9 ship. STANDING CORRECTION ADOPTED HERE: the framing states cite the design doc's sections and v1's implementation as evidence, so the reconciliation the owner ruled is recorded rather than remembered.

ADJUDICATION: the owner blesses the LAST gate (gate_release) from their phone - which is also this iteration's killer demonstration. Every earlier gate is self-blessed under the standing delegation.
